implementation_summary: TypeScript/Node 22 pnpm monorepo (types, checkers, core, runner, wizard) built as a self-check release tool. Of 45 REQs: 6 COMPLETE (URL check, crawl, sitemap merge, Sign-in Wall skip, BYOK, robots.txt), 19 PARTIAL (crawl limits, JS rendering, App Flow, extraction, content/marketing checks, AI review, ranking, review edits, MD/JSON export, roadmap, history, pacing, payment flagging, mobile, a11y/SEO basics, model per task, key encryption, secret scanning), 19 MISSING (sections, CMS, external speed/search APIs, language, documents, pitch, PDF/Word, shortlist, preview, owner audit, proposal, rewrite, pricing, Hindi, helpers, free tiers, EN/TA, redesign/repair), 1 UNVERIFIED (local vs Cloud Run). Reusable building blocks are recorded for each PARTIAL item.

questions: Should per-page audit rows (REQ-009/014/015/037/038) cover every crawled page, or keep the current Layout Group sampling (3 Sample Pages) used by the checkers?
Does ADR 0031 (pinned resolver for every outbound request) cover robots.txt fetches and local preflight, which use global fetch today?
Should REQ-002 depth and path filters add new Skipped Page reasons (depth-limit, excluded) to CONTEXT.md?
risks: Baseline test status unknown: pnpm test was not run
Checkers run only on Sample Pages at one SEO screen size, so 'every page' acceptance criteria need a coverage decision
Two crawlers (DeterministicSpider, SafePublicCrawler) with separate pacing and robots code; an audit mode could add a third
Hosted copy loses history on redeploy or scale-down (/tmp, ADR 0032), which affects REQ-028 and REQ-033
Plaintext key fallback file conflicts with REQ-040
Broad keyword grep for pitch/shortlist/proposal features was not triaged; the MISSING calls rest on route and file lists
handoff: Planner: use the 'Reusable building blocks' table in engineering/repo-analysis.md. The main seam is a content-extraction step in DeterministicSpider.evaluatePage (deterministic-spider.ts:887-929) that stores text, headings, images/alt, meta, CTAs, lang and sections on PageInventoryItem; REQ-005, 008, 009, 013, 014 and 044 build on it. Crawl-limit work goes through RunStartBody, DiscoveryOptions and CrawlOptions. Settle the coverage question (sampled vs every page) and Q-01 (positioning) before planning documents, pitch or shortlist.
